author: CodingEntrepreneurs
description:
⭐️ Branch Postgres for every AI agent with Xata: https://xata.io
⭐️ Get Managed Postgres + real-time analytics with ClickHouse: https://clickhouse.com/cloud/postgres

Agents have been guessing what happens in production for far too long. Or we hand them the production database, and it goes catastrophically wrong.

The fix: give every agent an isolated branch of production with the sensitive data masked. If it drops the orders table or runs a migration that breaks, production is untouched.

In this video, I build the whole stack from scratch with Python and Django: production on ClickHouse Managed Postgres, page view analytics you fully own in ClickHouse, and an anonymized mirror of production in Xata. Then we branch it, migrate one branch, delete rows on another, and watch production and every other branch stay exactly the same.
